title: Fix Quality and Outliers: Weighing a Fix by What the Receiver Says It Is, Refusing One That Is Too Far From Where the Robot Is, and Taking One Back After Too Many Refusals

artifact.note: a position filter fed by GNSS fixes whose noise is taken from the fix level (fixed, float, single, none), that tests each fix against the filter's own prediction with a chi-square gate and refuses one that is too far, and that takes the next fix as a new start after too many refusals in a row
